listing.name: Haunting Ground — hg2 (KunoDemetries)
listing.summary: This project uses its own ahead-of-time tools and runtime, without PS2Recomp. A menu and 6,300-frame diagnostic run do not establish playable gameplay. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS21075 disc and executable. The required revision is not confirmed here; check upstream’s configuration before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the local source and code-generation instructions. HG2 is separate from the same author’s PS2Recomp-based HG project.

warnings: This project uses its own ahead-of-time tools and runtime, without PS2Recomp. A menu and 6,300-frame diagnostic run do not establish playable gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
